_doc: Accounts excluded from all metrics: our own accounts, seeded/placeholder rows, QA and test accounts, and automated browser/HTTP clients. Every excluded account is still COUNTED and surfaced in the report so exclusions are never silent. Patterns are SQL ILIKE (use % as wildcard). userAgentRegex is a POSIX regex matched case-insensitively against auth.sessions.user_agent — a user is excluded if ANY of their sessions matches.

global._userAgentRegexDoc: Four groups, in order. (1) Automation drivers and HTTP clients. (2) Self-declaring crawlers: `bot/` catches ClaudeBot/Googlebot/bingbot/AhrefsBot etc, and the `+http` / `+contact@` forms catch anything advertising a contact URL or address the way the robots convention asks. (3) Named agents that declare themselves but match neither of the above — Claude-User and Perplexity-User are USER-INITIATED fetchers with their own UA, distinct from ClaudeBot, and Dataprovider.com names itself with no marker at all. (4) Impossible UAs: a null header stringified to `None`, legacy EdgeHTML (Edge/12-18, retired 2020) bolted onto a modern Chrome token, a truncated `Safari/537.3` (real is 537.36), `Mac OS X 8_` (never existed; real is 10_x or 14_x+), and AppleWebKit/558 (real is 537.36 or 605.1.15). Each of group 4 was observed in this project's traffic on 2026-08-06 and none can be emitted by a real browser. Verified: this costs 0 real signed-in accounts.
global._emailExactDoc: Owner accounts, global because the same person signs into every app. brassmonkey381@msn.com matches Brian's GitHub handle and signs in from his dev machine (confirmed 2026-08-04).
global._ipsDoc: IP exclusions live in .env as EXCLUDED_IPS (comma-separated), NOT here — an IP address identifies a physical location and this file is committed. They exclude ANONYMOUS GUESTS ONLY: real signed-in accounts are never dropped by IP, because a dev box shares its address with everyone else on that network (a genuine external user has signed in from the dev IP, which is exactly why this rule is guest-scoped). Exclude real accounts by email instead.
